description: Use this when you cite a value and need to know whether it changed, was corrected or withdrawn, or to re-check a value you stored earlier. Every attribute from get_product carries a statement_id that stays the same across new values, withdrawals and merges; this returns every version oldest first (value, verification_state, confidence_recorded, recorded_at, ended_by superseded/withdrawn with the reason, sources) and the changes attached to it, each marked if it was corrected.

statement_id.description: The statement_id from an attribute or scoped value of get_product, or from a change.

name: get_statement
title: The history of one statement
